description: Save a generated image or video into the user's My Media library permanently ("save this", "keep it"). Results otherwise expire 1 hour after they finish. Pass the result URL; it is safety-checked before it is kept.

job_id.description: The jobId that produced it, when known.

modality.description: Output type, when the URL does not make it obvious.

prompt.description: The prompt that produced it, so it is findable in the library later.

tool_name.description: Model apiId that produced it, when known.

url.description: The result URL to keep (image or video from a PixelDojo job).

name: pixeldojo_save
title: Save to My Media
